full_description: Focus Mode is a productivity app designed to help users stay focused and avoid distractions. It provides a set of tools and features to boost concentration and efficiency, allowing you to achieve your goals and get more done in less time. With Focus Mode, you can prioritize your tasks, set timers, and track your progress. The app also includes features such as website blockers, notification filters, and customizable focus modes to help you stay on track. Whether you're a student, professional, or anyone looking to improve your productivity, Focus Mode is the perfect tool to help you stay focused and achieve your goals.
